morphology.pattern_note: 词根以 d 开头时，meN- 实现为 men-，保留 d；-kan 表示使动。输入包将派生词误判为词根，此处依据 DBP 的 debar 词条修正。[DBP：debar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=debar)

word_family.gloss: 心怦怦跳；因紧张等而心跳加快

senses.zh_definition: 使心脏或脉搏因紧张、恐惧、期待或兴奋而加快跳动；引申为使人紧张、扣人心弦。
senses.en_definition: To make the heart beat faster through anxiety, fear, anticipation, or excitement; to thrill or create suspense.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan atau menyebabkan jantung atau nadi berdenyut agak pantas kerana timbul perasaan cemas, takut dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 强调引发心跳或紧张感的事物。人自身感到心跳加快通常用 berdebar；cerita yang mendebarkan 表示故事扣人心弦，不一定令人害怕。虽常译成英语形容词 thrilling，马来语构词上仍是使动动词。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Perlawanan akhir itu mendebarkan penonton hingga ke saat terakhir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那场决赛直到最后一刻都让观众紧张不已。
dual_scenarios.en: The final kept spectators on the edge of their seats until the very last moment.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Babak akhir tu memang mendebarkan, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Babak akhir itu memang mendebarkan, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 最后那一幕真的很紧张，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: That final scene was really tense, wasn't it?
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式
句末 kan 用于寻求认同
dah 对应 sudah，nak 对应 hendak

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok filem tu? Babak akhir dia memang mendebarkan!
messages.ms_standard: Awak sudah menonton filem itu? Babak akhirnya memang mendebarkan!
messages.zh: 你看那部电影了吗？最后那一幕真的扣人心弦！
messages.en: Have you seen that film? The final scene is really intense!

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum, aku nak tengok malam ni. Jangan bocorkan pengakhiran dia, ya!
messages.ms_standard: Belum, saya hendak menontonnya malam ini. Jangan beritahu saya pengakhirannya, ya!
messages.zh: 还没，我今晚想看。别剧透结局啊！
messages.en: Not yet. I'm planning to watch it tonight. Don't spoil the ending!

etymology.historical_story: Malay debar denotes a heartbeat or pulse. The derived verb mendebarkan makes that bodily experience causative: something sets the heart racing. Its use for gripping stories connects physical sensation with narrative suspense. DBP records both the bodily meaning and literary examples, but the supplied evidence does not establish an earliest date or a deeper historical origin. [DBP: debar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=debar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 debar＝心跳：berdebar 是自己心怦怦跳，mendebarkan 是某件事让你心怦怦跳。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 本词语气中性，可用于新闻、影评和日常交流。与长辈或不熟悉的人交谈时，例句中的 kau 应换为适当称呼或较礼貌的代词。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合描述比赛、悬念和紧张的消息。谈及他人真实的惊恐经历时，应避免用兴奋的语气把其遭遇当作娱乐。
